source.title: GPU-Accelerated Quantum Simulation of Stabilizer Circuits

source_reported_results.largest_reported_benchmark: up to 180,000 qubits, depth 1,000, approximately 130 million gates
source_reported_results.reported_runtime_speedup: up to 105x on selected benchmark instances
source_reported_results.verification_note: Source-reported results; UQPU has not reproduced them.

applicability_boundary: Not a generic simulator for arbitrary non-Clifford QAOA rotations. Do not substitute for the parity-QAOA simulation gate except for genuinely Clifford subcircuits or separate stabilizer/QEC workloads.
acceptance_contract: Pin source commit, dependencies, hardware, drivers, benchmark suite, seeds and manifests.
Verify exact output/syndrome correctness before timing.
Separate warm-up/setup, steady-state and end-to-end runtime.
Record throughput, peak host/device memory, transfer bytes/time, host work, retries and energy where measurable.
Compare matched baseline versions/configurations and test a held-out circuit family.
Preserve failed cases and label unmeasured energy components UNKNOWN.
nonclaims: No real-QPU execution or quantum advantage.
No generic QAOA simulation or parity-QAOA result.
No Data-Center-to-One-Phone, material, bio-oil, fusion, finance or new-physics result.
next_gate: Implement parity-QAOA against exact small-graph objective/decoder certificates; in parallel reproduce a bounded QuaSARQ stabilizer workload with full task-boundary accounting.
